assessment.cleanup: Compose shutdown and daemon stop were independently checked. Directory removal returned nonzero. Subsequent read-only guest inspections found the exact root-owned private directory still existed, with matching mount records of one signature in 9 namespaces and 0 related processes. These records do not establish the number of distinct mount instances. The specific CA key, server key, API key and source .env paths were absent; other possible secrets were not examined. No further removal was attempted, and complete directory cleanup was not verified.
